'''The Black Sphere''' was a ball of naturally occurring [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], marked with tiny white impurities that gave it the impression of stars shining from within.

It was highly revered by the natives of [[Eckless]]. Other people, such as [[Jorga Sune]], believed it held the coordinates to the planet Eckless.
